THE CHART ON THE WALL

Patterns & connections

Your details stay in this tab while you explore. Nothing is written to browser storage or sent for local charts. AI requests send the chart details you choose to share.

Choosing a listed city fills its coordinates and historical time zone. For another city, enter these explicitly. Unknown time omits houses, the Ascendant, and the hour pillar.

Chart settings & methods

Planet positions: Astronomy Engine. Whole-sign houses use an approximate Ascendant calculation. Sidereal uses an approximate Lahiri offset. BaZi: lunar-javascript solar terms evaluated in China time, day/hour in local civil time, midnight day boundary, no true-solar correction. Both luck directions are shown until a convention is chosen. Daily transits use 12:00 UTC. An unknown birth time uses noon estimates.

A reading together

Explore the symbols, or add your birth details to compare.

Interpretations are symbolic, not predictions of an actual meeting or a guaranteed relationship. Five Phases is an educational correspondence view, not a health assessment.

AI connection

The studio connects to its Render host automatically. Local guide works while it wakes up. Never enter an API key here.

Chat stays in this tab. When AI is connected, your messages and selected chart details are sent to the server and Google. The studio endpoint does not save them; Google may retain API data under its policies. Game journals are separate.
